title: Kicked Spicy Canadian Penne Pasta
description: A spicy and tender Canadian dish featuring penne rigate, perfect for a post-workout meal
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne rigate according to package instructions
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and cook the ground beef until browned
Add the agave syrup, hot sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine
Drain the cooked penne rigate and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the beef mixture
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
